description: Story Mode, final page composition and broadcast layout, README, and the full verification gate. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 (all sections and the data layer must exist). This leaves the dashboard production-ready.
steps: Create src/components/StoryMode.tsx: a subtle-but-prominent 'Story Mode / Talking Points' toggle wired to the DashboardProvider storyMode flag. When ON, use selectTopNarratives() from src/lib/stories.ts to surface/annotate the 3-5 most interesting narratives in the CURRENT filtered data (biggest over-target, biggest ignored, a one-receiver offense, a man/zone specialist, a notable checkdown pattern), e.g. a highlighted talking-points strip plus annotation emphasis in the relevant sections.

Finalize app/page.tsx and app/globals.css: dark high-contrast broadcast-monitor layout, desktop-first (~1920px), composing DashboardProvider > FilterBar (sticky) > Story Mode toggle/strip > HeadlineChart (hero) > Leaderboards > TeamPanels > BallFlow > CoverageProfile. Deliberate large type scale, bold player names, no tiny text, accessible contrast. Responsive but desktop-prioritized. Set app/layout.tsx metadata/title.

Replace the empty plan.md with a real README.md documenting: how to run (`npm install`, `npm run dev`, `npm run build`, `npm run generate-data`); the full receivers.json schema with a description of every column; the expectation formula (expectedTargetShare = clamp(a + b*openRate,0,1), toe = targetShare - expectedTargetShare) and where a/b live; and the EXACT zero-code-change steps to swap in real data (replace public/data/receivers.json with the same shape/column names; adjust expectationModel.a/.b if the model changes). Document the Recharts-vs-@nivo/sankey choice.
Run the full verification gate (npm install already done; run npm run build and the short-lived dev check) and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` and `npm run build` both succeed from the repo root with no errors.
A short-lived `npm run dev` check confirms no runtime/hydration errors and that all 5 sections (Headline Chart, Leaderboards, Team Panels, Ball Flow, Coverage Profile) render.
Toggling Story Mode highlights 3-5 narratives derived from the current filtered data.
Each filter (Week, Position, Coverage, Game) visibly changes output across the sections.
README.md documents run steps, the full data schema with column descriptions, the expectation formula, and the exact zero-code-change real-data swap procedure; plan.md is replaced.
verification: Short-lived dev check: start `npm run dev` in the background, wait ~5s, confirm all 5 sections render and Story Mode + filters work with no runtime/hydration errors, then STOP the dev server (never leave it running).
findings:
COMPLETED. Story Mode + final broadcast composition + README + verification gate.

- README.md (NEW, replaces repo-root plan.md): documents run steps (npm install/dev/build/start/lint, generate-data, check-data/check-logic), the full receivers.json schema with a per-column description table, the expectationModel sub-table, the expectation formula (expectedTargetShare = clamp(a + b*openRate,0,1); toe = targetShare - expectedTargetShare) and where a/b live (receivers.json.expectationModel mirrored in src/lib/toe.ts defaultModel, used ONLY for the scatter's expectedTargetShareLine reference line), the exact zero-code-change real-data swap procedure (replace public/data/receivers.json with same shape/column names; update a/b in both places if the model changes), and the Recharts-vs-@nivo/sankey rationale (Recharts for scatter/bar/quadrant, @nivo/sankey only for the one flow diagram). plan.md (tracked at repo root) is removed by this commit.
